episodes.title: Aswatthama
episodes.summary: A mysterious phone call from an anonymous man leads police officer Sartaj Singh on a chase around Mumbai in a dangerous cat-and-mouse game.

episodes.title: Halahala
episodes.summary: News of Ganesh Gaitonde creates a stir among Mumbai's VIPs, from politicians to film stars. Removed from the case, Sartaj begins his own investigation.

episodes.title: Aatapi Vatapi
episodes.summary: The woman found in the bunker leads Sartaj to Gaitonde's thug, Bunty. In a flashback, Gaitonde recalls stealing a lucky charm from rival Suleiman Isa.

episodes.title: Brahmahatya
episodes.summary: TV Starlet Nayanika visits Bunty with a hidden camera. In the mid-'80s, Gaitonde discovers a racket even more lucrative than drugs and guns: politics.

episodes.title: Sarama
episodes.summary: To save Nayanika, Sartaj intervenes during a RAW operation, In 1992, as political unrest increases, so does the bloodshed from Gaitonde and Isa's fued.

episodes.title: Pretakalps
episodes.summary: When Sartaj's constable, Katekar, is pressured to investigate the disappearance of a young man from a Muslim slum, disastrous consequences follow.

episodes.title: Rudra
episodes.summary: Hoping to tie up the many loose ends of their case, Sartaj and Anjali reunite to figure out how the enigmatic Trivedi is linked to Gatonde's prophecy.

episodes.title: Yayati
episodes.summary: To save Mumbai from impending doom, Sartaj races against time to find out who Gaitonde's third father is and what's planned to happen on the 25th day.

episodes.title: Matsya
episodes.summary: After making a discovery in Gaitonde's bunker, Sartaj joins a mission to foil a deadly conspiracy. In 1994, Gaitonde resurfaces in a new location.

episodes.title: Siduri
episodes.summary: With the terrorist-cell investigation underway, Sartaj visits Guruji's ashram. In the late '90s, Gaitonde is urged to seek a spiritual anchor.

episodes.title: Apasmara
episodes.summary: Sartaj traces how Shahid Khan's nuclear consignment was delivered to India. In the early 2000s, Gaitonde takes bold action to maintain his notoriety.

episodes.title: Bardo
episodes.summary: Sartaj's team tries to reach Shahid Khan via an internet chatroom. In 2003, Gaitonde's growing disenchantment with his life brings him closer to Guruji.

episodes.title: Vikarna
episodes.summary: As Sartaj's team baits a trap for Shahid Khan, Majid suspects a department member. Immersed in ashram life, Gaitonde learns of Guruji's lethal plans.

episodes.title: Azrael
episodes.summary: Batya lets Sartaj in on several secrets, leaving him reeling and conflicted. Gaitonde returns to Mumbai to set Guruji's destructive plan in motion.

episodes.title: Torino
episodes.summary: After committing a drastic act, Gaitonde can't silence Guruji's voice in his mind. Parulkar reaches a shocking realization. Sartaj makes a breakthrough.

episodes.title: Radcliffe
episodes.summary: Unsettling truths, complex betrayals and unforeseen connections emerge for Sartaj, Gaitonde and Shahid Khan as doomsday descends on Mumbai.
